No beat is directed again before the script for it is open.

unresolved_conflicts_for_julian.why: Satisfies the script (fascia), the manuscript's 'gold letters that have refused to fade', and the v5 consumer-title lock ('always Thistlewood's with the apostrophe') simultaneously. No source loses.

hero_prop_law.the_sound: A French tune, sweet and WRONG. 'The same notes bent the same way, every time.' The manuscript is emphatic: 'Not broken wrong. Not clunk and jangle wrong.'
hero_prop_law.why_it_is_law: A box that sounds broken can simply be fixed, and the episode has no mystery. A box that is crooked ON PURPOSE is the entire plot, the reveal, and the ending. MP.B1 described it as 'three halting notes, the third one sour' — backwards.
hero_prop_law.the_worn_place: A small worn place on the lid where a thumb has rested for a hundred years. It is the episode's rhyme: Rose sees it in Act One, Pascal's thumb rests on the same spot in 1867, Richard polishes it in Act Three, Tom touches it at the end. Every plate of the box must carry it.
hero_prop_law.NO_CRACK: The box is NOT damaged and must not read as damaged. The script: a piece is MISSING, and the mechanism was BUILT WRONG ON PURPOSE. TP-01's visible crack in the comb was interpreted before the script was found, and 'the crack is the wound' is retired. An EMPTY SOCKET where the crooked cam belongs is canon; a crack is not. A cracked box is a box someone broke, which makes it a repair job. This box was made this way by a master with steady hands and a full heart, which is the entire story.

the_apron_ritual: Over the head, tied at the back, both hands smoothing the front — then, and only then, he lifts the box. Then he goes very still. Manuscript: 'like a knight settling his armour.' Its first appearance sets it for the series.
arc_seeds_in_the_tag: The gold paint tin never gets emptier. Albert checked twice and drew lines.
Everything the door gives them is wrong — except their shoes. Script broadens the manuscript's 'Peggi's clogs' to 'why do OUR shoes fit?'
A small wooden box on Richard's high shelf, behind the solvent jars. He looked at it for half a second before turning out the light.
Richard's closing line about his wife's clock — 'Your grandmother's clock says quarter past. It's half three. I'll have a look at THAT next.'

single_reference_law.law: Both working render routes accept exactly ONE reference image. A character model pack cannot travel into a shot alongside an environment plate.
single_reference_law.consequence: Identity must already be present in the frame handed to the model. Every shot therefore needs its own KEYFRAME — the approved plate with the characters staged in their OPENING pose — not a plate plus sheets.
single_reference_law.keyframe_is_the_first_frame: A keyframe shows where the shot BEGINS, never where it ends. Specifying the end state makes the video play backwards. This was caught once already on TP-03 and is now law.
single_reference_law.escape_hatch: If fal repairs bytedance/seedance-2.5/reference-to-video (currently billing a full inference then returning 422 on image_urls), multi-reference returns and the per-shot keyframe burden drops to plate + sheets.
